title: Query Options
description: Learn all the options available for configuring queries.

data.text: useQuery accepts many options to control caching, refetching, and behavior.

data.title: Options
staleTime vs gcTime
data.text: staleTime controls when data is considered stale (triggers refetch). gcTime controls how long unused data stays in cache.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Query options give you fine-grained control.
